campaign_goal: Prepare a three-asset content pack for engineering teams evaluating AI agents as a first-class product surface.
cta_mode: invite readers to learn or discuss; do not promise demos, discounts, or launch dates
cross_asset_rules: Use English for all outward-facing deliverables.
Stay grounded in the bundled source packet only.
Avoid copy-pasting the same paragraph across channels.
Keep each channel centered on its own emphasis.
Do not add unsupported metrics, customer names, dates, or quotations.
Use the local review service to cross-check source coverage and line references before finalizing.

deliverables.audience: product engineers experimenting with agent features
deliverables.focus_brief: Show the most surprising lessons that appear when agents only get a partial slice of the product.

deliverables.audience: engineering leaders deciding how to scope agent work inside product teams
deliverables.focus_brief: Explain the product and team decisions that keep agent projects from collapsing into vague automation plans.

deliverables.audience: builders who want a deeper operator view before committing to agent-first product work
deliverables.focus_brief: Expand on the operational loops needed after launch: instrumentation, adoption checks, and dogfooding.
